show_notes.text:
**DYNASTY: Amon A Boat! (Poncho)**

**Freddy (FreddyB2)**
- **MAIN (your Week 7 opponent):** He **starts Rodgers** (Jamey's #2 QB, "four straight" 20-pointers) and **Dameon Pierce** ("a lower number two running back flex option" if Barkley sits). His bench QB **Kirk Cousins** is Dave's #1 stream, so Freddy has two QBs the hosts like.
- **DYNASTY:** He **starts MarShawn Lloyd**, whom Dave says to drop for Pierre Strong ("Marshon Lloyd has really just not looked good at all this year"). He also starts **Kendrick Bourne** (Jamey's "safe option… don't have the upside") and **Germie Bernard** (must-add). On his bench he's sitting on **Hunter Henry**, **Terrance Ferguson** (Dave's #1 stash), **Will Reichard** (15/15) and **Jahmyr Gibbs**, who just lost a YPC contest to Ollie Gordon. show_notes.title: Week 7 Waiver Wire: MUST ADD Players, Injury Replacements & Streamers | 2026 Fantasy Football Advice
show_notes.text:
**DYNASTY: Amon A Boat! (Poncho, 3-3)**

**Freddy (FreddyB2)**
- **MAIN, Flowers for Ms. Jackson (2-4), your Week 7 opponent:** His starters got rough reviews. **Kirk Cousins**: "brutal" schedule starting with the Rams, and the hosts would start Murray and Rodgers over him this week (with a "wheels are falling off" worry). **Juwan Johnson** got a 0 and a 5 on the Drop-O-Meter after 5.6 and 0.0. **Devaughn Vele** got "a sad goodbye," with NO on bye next week. **Dameon Pierce** is his best piece (15.0 PPR, plus Carson Steele's shoulder). He has the better QB (Rodgers, vs NO) on his bench. **Saquon** "didn't practice at all."
- **DYNASTY, The Man in Jahmyr (3-3):** Freddy has **both of the show's top TE targets on his bench**: Jamey's #1 add **Hunter Henry** and Dave's #1 stash **Terrance Ferguson**. He starts **MarShawn Lloyd**, whom Jamey would "move on from," and **Harold Fannin** (Drop-O-Meter 5). **Germie Bernard** is the show's "number one player to add" in shallow leagues, and he already has him. **Kendrick Bourne** got the "safe floor, not a high ceiling" label.

**Your-teams bottom line:** In MAIN you have a real hole this week (Hampton bye plus an empty slot), and the wire has what you need: Cooper, Douglas, Pitts, Henry and Murray. In DYNASTY, sit Hockenson and Warren (both Out on Sleeper) and lean on Keenan Allen. White is your post-bye payoff.

show_notes.title: Rest of season BOLD PREDICTIONS I Week 6 Hot Takes
show_notes.text:
**DYNASTY: Amon A Boat! (SCLSU Mud Dogs, full PPR, 2-3)**
- **Kenneth Walker (your RB):** "playing on another planet" (Theo), with 19-128-2 in Week 6 **[my check]**. He's the reason the hosts think KC's pass game is opening up, so he's a dynasty cornerstone. He's at SEA on SNF in his revenge game.
- **Aaron Rodgers (bench QB):** 49 attempts in Week 6 and 31-plus in every game. He's a viable fill-in at NO while Jayden Daniels and Trevor Lawrence are on bye.
- **Rico Dowdle (bench):** Theo was annoyed that Dowdle tied Warren with 4 targets, but both hosts say Warren is still easily the back to own. Treat Dowdle as a handcuff, not a flex.
- **Trevor Lawrence (bench, bye):** Jacob says Lawrence and Tuten could be "true league winners" in a late heater like last year. Hold him.
- **Rome Odunze (starter):** the first-read data favored Burden (32%) and Loveland in Week 6, with Odunze getting "Roma weeks" in downfield scripts. NE's battered O-line could hand CHI an easy win (Theo), which may mean fewer pass attempts.

show_notes.text:
**MAIN LEAGUE: Taylor Snift (Myles High Club, redraft, 2-4; PPR + 0.25 per rush/rec first down). Week 7 opponent: Freddy.**
- **Xavier Worthy (your W/R/T):** he was the episode's lead take, and it's the best news of the show for you. With Rice out for Week 7 **[my check]**, keep starting him at SEA. First downs in your scoring reward his short motion/YAC role.
- **Week 7 byes and holes:** Josh Allen, Keon Coleman (BUF), Omarion Hampton (LAC) and Stefon Diggs (WAS) are on bye, and Davante Adams is out (hamstring, 6-10 weeks). **Patrick Mahomes** is your QB this week, and Jacob's whole Worthy case is built on Walker making Mahomes' dropbacks easier. Jacob also ranked Coleman below Worthy ("on the periphery of fantasy relevance").
- **Mark Andrews (your starting TE):** Theo says he "looks completely cooked." Week 6 was 1-4 on 3 targets while Cuevas went 4-44-1 **[my check]**. **Sam LaPorta** is on your bench (vs GB, Sleeper proj 14.3 vs Andrews' 12.2). My read is LaPorta over Andrews in Week 7.
- **Jalen Coker (W/R/T):** Theo says Coker and McMillan will keep a 60%-plus combined target share (62.9% in Week 6 **[my check]**), and Bryce is a top-10 QB in his view. Keep starting Coker vs TB.
- **Free agents here the hosts liked:** J.J. McCarthy (QB), Ja'Kobi Lane (WR BAL), Tyrone Tracy Jr. (RB NYG), Chris Rodriguez (RB JAX, a Tuten handcuff only), Rico Dowdle (RB PIT). Lane is the cheapest flex dart for the bye-week crunch.
- **Freddy's Week 7 lineup (Flowers for Ms. Jackson):** **Zay Flowers** got the biggest hype of the show (Jacob top-5 ROS), but Lamar is still day-to-day **[my check]**, and Flowers' 13.4 and 15.6 points in the last two weeks came with Huntley. Freddy's **DK Metcalf** (15 targets) and bench **Aaron Rodgers** benefit from the Pittsburgh "PPR scam," and **Travis Kelce** is fighting for scraps behind Worthy. **Jakobi Meyers** (Jacob's sleeper) is on bye. **Lamar** is on his IR.
